fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls and NPC undressing. v0.34.3 keeps the validated local furniture CumOverlays replay from v0.34.2 and changes only the remote STR proxy replay: instead of the proxy-only RemoveOverlays/AddOverlays hard reinstall, furniture replays now directly reapply the owner-authoritative CumOverlays to the existing Body [OvlN] geometry and request a lightweight RaceMenu update. This avoids the transient duplicate CumOverlays slots observed on Player1 while preserving the free-scene and PPA paths.
